videos.title: man in the mirror & Artist of the century
videos.description: We're starting off the week with something more recent. MIKE brings two songs together to help present us something so simple yet complicated in all of the small details. This is one that really inspired me to get this project running.

videos.title: Ignorance
videos.description: Imagine 2012, playing AdventureQuest Worlds, and suddenly I'm enthralled by this video popping up on YouTube. Truly one of my first inspirations.

videos.title: Go Up ft. Cat Power
videos.description: Cassius, Pharrell and Cat Power work to create an incredible electronic dance track and top it off with a masterclass in creativity by the director Alexandre Courtès.

videos.title: Stylo
videos.description: With such striking vocals from Bobby Womack and an appearance from Bruce Willis, this video embodies what the track feels like, quite the chase.

videos.title: The Pretender
videos.description: It was hard to choose what to put last, but this is another one of those formative videos that I first saw on MTV growing up. Foo Fighters, while not my favorite band these days, will always be so important because of how early I was introduced to them.
